title: Prospective evaluation of an artificial intelligence-enabled algorithm for automated diabetic retinopathy screening of 30 000 patients.
summary: A prospective AI-enabled algorithm triages diabetic-retinopathy screening images in a 30,000-patient programme against human grading.
ai_technology: The source reports prospective deployment/test in the English screening programme and PPV/NPV against graders; most algorithm-negative cases lacked referable retinopathy.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A prospective AI-enabled algorithm triages diabetic-retinopathy screening images in a 30,000-patient programme against human grading.
evidence.unknown: The prospective program compared AI triage with human grading in 30,000 patients; the source does not establish improved patient outcomes from AI use.
